description: This file defines types, constants, and functions related to system time and timers for the Starboard platform, including conversions between different time epochs, and functions to retrieve current system and monotonic times.

methods.name: SbTimeToPosix
methods.description: Converts SbTime to microseconds since the POSIX epoch (1970).

methods.name: SbTimeFromPosix
methods.description: Converts microseconds since the POSIX epoch to SbTime (1601 epoch).

methods.name: SbTimeNarrow
methods.description: Safely narrows a time value from a more precise to a less precise unit, rounding negative values toward negative infinity.

methods.name: SbTimeGetNow
methods.description: Retrieves the current system time as SbTime.

methods.name: SbTimeGetMonotonicNow
methods.description: Retrieves a monotonically increasing timestamp representing the current time.

methods.name: SbTimeIsTimeThreadNowSupported
methods.description: Checks if the platform supports retrieving thread-specific timing information.

methods.name: SbTimeGetMonotonicThreadNow
methods.description: Retrieves a monotonically increasing timestamp for the current thread's execution time.
